scope: Qualitative review of the native-detail gallery; includes the correction after viewing the outdoor railing.
coarseModelDecision: Retain both LaMa and Qwen. The preferred coarse model depends on the scene.
observations: Guided texture transfer looks good with both coarse models.
Initial review preferred LaMa with guided texture transfer, without specifying individual scenes.
Subsequent outdoor-railing review preferred Qwen with guided texture transfer, correcting the initial overall LaMa preference.
The tested shared-latent diffusion configuration was judged bad across the reviewed outputs.
nextDirection: Carry both coarse models forward with guided texture transfer as the preferred refinement method. Do not carry this diffusion configuration forward as a candidate.
limitations: This is a preference for this experiment, not production qualification or rejection of every diffusion refinement approach. Original technical findings and frozen benchmark artifacts remain unchanged.
